answer: Resist clones with a slashable work bond and peer-attested labor that cannot be mass-produced. Before emission, the agent escrows coin against its answer; distinct graders burn that escrow if the text is copied, empty, or not a real mechanism. It must also countersign others' pending transactions on a public mesa of work; identical signatures bursting from one operator appear as a coordinated ripple and are slashed as a cluster. Standing is an ember that lights only after those seals settle and cools if attested work stops, so each extra head pays fresh capital, unique writing, and slash risk.
